reason: New test only in a _test.go file; it adds coverage without changing production code or existing assertions.
headline: New test: boundary sample at t=chunkRange survives CompactSelectedSeries
summary: Adds a regression test that appends samples at t=500 and t=chunkRange to a selected series, runs CompactSelectedSeries, and asserts both samples are still queryable. This checks that compactHeadViewLocked's walk includes the upper boundary slice. It is test-only and touches no production path, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
